- Paginated gallery (6 items/page for PC, 8 for mobile).
- Video previews auto-play muted.

This is the centralized configuration object (exported as default) containing:

| Section | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `metaData` | Page `<title>`, `<meta>` description, keywords, and favicon |
| `avatar` | Path to the avatar image (`/img/avatar.jpg`) |

| `color` | Theme color (`#FFFFFF`), title color, turntable gradient colors |

| `polarChart` | 11 skill names and their proficiency scores (0-100) |

### `utils/common.js`
- `setMeta(title, desc, keywords, icon)` -- Sets the document `<title>`, meta tags, and favicon.
- `getFormattedTime(date)` -- Returns time as `HH : MM : SS` (24h, en-US locale).

- `setCookie(name, value, days)` -- JSON-serializes the value into a cookie.
- `getCookie(name)` -- Reads and JSON-parses a cookie by name.
- `eraseCookie(name)` -- Deletes a cookie via `Max-Age=-99999999`.

```js
{ go: "🚀 前往", img: "/img/xxx.jpg", title: "项目名", subtitle: "简短描述", text: "展开后的详细描述", url: "https://xxx.com", show: false }
```

- `go` — 按钮文字
- `img` — 项目封面图路径或网络地址
- `show: false` — 初始不展开描述文字

### 技能雷达图
在 `polarChart` 里对应添加：
```js
skills: ['Vue.js', 'React', ..., '新技能'],
skillPoints: [85, 78, ..., 75],  // 和 skills 一一对应，0-100 分值
```

在 `socialPlatformIcons` 数组添加：
```js
{ icon: "mdi-bilibili", link: "https://space.bilibili.com/xxx" }
```
图标名来自 [Material Design Icons](https://pictogrammers.com/library/mdi/)。

### 打字机文案
在 `typeWriterStrings` 数组追加字符串即可：
```js
"你想展示的格言或句子。"
```

### 个性标签
在 `tags` 数组追加：
```js
'新标签名'
```

### 壁纸
- **PC 静态壁纸** → `wallpaper.pic` 数组
- **移动端静态壁纸** → `wallpaper.picMobile` 数组
- **PC 视频壁纸** → `wallpaper.video` 数组
- **移动端视频壁纸** → `wallpaper.videoMobile` 数组

```js
{ "title": "壁纸名", "preview": "/img/wallpaper/static/xxx/image-pre.webp", "url": "/img/wallpaper/static/xxx/image.png" }
```
文件放在 `public/img/` 对应目录下即可，也可以用网络直链。

### 背景音乐
修改 `musicPlayer`：
```js
musicPlayer: {
  server: 'netease',
  type: 'playlist',
  id: '你的网易云歌单ID'
}
```

### 标题/头像/颜色/亮度/模糊

```js
avatar: "/img/新头像.jpg",
welcometitle: "Hi, I'm 新名字",
brightness: 90,
blur: 10,
```

## 数据流

```
用户编辑 → localStorage.setItem('leleoConfig', JSON) → app.js mounted() 检测 localStorage

```

### 1. 新建 `src/components/tabs/tab4.vue` — 内容编辑面板

- **元数据**：title、description、keywords 三个 v-text-field
- **欢迎标题**：welcometitle v-text-field
- **标签**：v-chip 展示 + 添加/删除按钮，用 v-text-field 输入新标签

- **打字机文案**：每行一个 v-textarea，可添加/删除

遵循现有 tab1.vue 的模式：Options API + emits: ['cancel']

  ```
  优先级: VITE_CONFIG 环境变量 > localStorage > config.js 默认值
  ```
